notes.title: Welcome back to La Rocca!
notes.notes:
Surfasaurus is a game that's nearly a decade old, and upon revisiting it a couple years ago I thought with minimal effort I could probably greatly improve it with a solid couple of months of dedicated time. Being in-between projects, this slowly happened for a couple years! We're here now!

The game a spin-off from Mr. Triangle's Adventure, a game with an intentionally simple art style. While updating a giant 30+ hour RPG feels daunting, updating a single town and a few rooms doesn't. In the town, all of the background art is elevated. There are also ambient sounds to enjoy, everything you step on (wood, sand, grass, carpet), certain rooms like the power plant and the kitchen now have background sounds to further detail them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28139859/7b4963982baae85848704f1f3eef11fab6d53405.png[/img]

The core of the game is massively the same. If you've played the game before and have a save file, the idea is that this could be a fun romp to look at it again. If you're a new player, you're going to have a fantastic experience taking in this town for the first time!
